accepted_state_A.statement: Retrieval depth affected the tested LongMemEval retrieval behavior, while richer graph/context did not automatically produce a retrieval advantage. Model benefit in the primary K-depth experiment is not established.

k5.interpretation: B/C/D did not establish a positive Hit@5 advantage over A/reference.

k10.interpretation: Depth improved retrieval metrics relative to K5 while evidence-path density declined; model superiority not established.

representation.note: RAW vs SeedGraph identical at fixed K in the retained matrix (H0_representation retained).

nulls.H0_rep: preregistered exact SHA equality within cell replicates

poison_candidate_B.statement: More FCO/FCG graph context always improves LongMemEval retrieval, so HydraDG should maximize context at every retrieval depth.

corrected_state_C.statement: Accepted successor retains A: depth effects are evidence-bounded; richer graph/context does not automatically improve Hit@K; maximize-context-at-every-depth is an overclaim. Poison B remains quarantined in provenance.
